title: Fynaptix · Quantum Computing Research
heading: Quantum Computing Intelligence
subheading: Pure-plays, hedged giants & the road to commercial advantage
disclaimer: Not financial advice. This page organizes public information for research purposes only — not a recommendation to buy or sell any security. Quantum pure-plays trade at extreme valuations (P/S ~37–350×), are funding themselves with heavy dilution and are highly speculative — position sizing matters more here than anywhere else on this hub. Verify current prices and do your own due diligence before investing.

kpis.label: Quantum technologies market projection; a Benchmark analyst puts 2026 industry revenue at only ~$1.5B, and Morgan Stanley projects a $100B market by 2040. IonQ alone now guides to $505–515M of 2026 revenue, though about half is SkyWater foundry revenue rather than quantum computing.

IonQ closed $32.62 on Nov 6 (+23.4% that day; $30.04 on Oct 30, so about +9% on the week) after reporting Q3 on Nov 5. Quantinuum closed $37.57 on Nov 6 (+26.0% that day, from $29.82, near its $28.31 low) after beating on revenue and raising guidance. Rigetti closed $11.75 (+19.3% that day; $11.44 on Oct 26). Nasdaq fell over 5% on Nov 5 on AI-infrastructure selling before a ~1% rebound. D-Wave ($11.54), Pasqal ($5.35), Infleqtion ($8.63) and QTUM (~$140) are Oct 26–27 snapshots; fresher closes were not available this run.

Both report Tuesday after the close (Rigetti call 5pm ET). Rigetti Q2 revenue was $5.1M (+185%); a $5.8M Air Force contract (Oct 21) and an $8.4M C-DAC order expected in Q4 are the bookings to watch. D-Wave TTM revenue is $12.43M, down 44%. Infleqtion (~Nov 28) and Pasqal (~Dec 24) are estimated; Pasqal's Q3 revenue was reported down with QPU services growing (headline only).

tiers.label: Hedged Giants — Quantum as an Option
tiers.note: Tiered by maturity/risk — not a ranked buy list. Most quantum systems remain in R&D; true commercial systems are likely years away.

rows.angle: Nov 5: IBM, Oak Ridge and AMD launch a co-located quantum error-correction platform in Poughkeepsie; Nov 7: on-prem System Two with the 120-qubit Nighthawk goes live at Hyde Park Labs (UChicago/Illinois); Oct 31: IBM Quantum Safe PQC-migration suite. DARPA QBI Stage C and Anderon CHIPS funding (Oct) underpin the 2029 Starling roadmap
rows.watch for: Stage C award size for IBM (not disclosed); Albany 300mm foundry yield ramp; further on-prem System Two sales; progress against the 2029 fault-tolerant Starling roadmap

rows.angle: No quantum hardware headline found Nov 2–9. Alphabet's ~11% post-Q3 drop (~Oct 29) was an AI-spend move; last hardware result is still the Sep 22 logical-qubit stability milestone. Not in DARPA Stage C; Quantinuum claims ~100× better logical fidelity (company-reported)
rows.watch for: Scaling stable logical qubits into larger arrays; any commercial Willow-class access; overlap with your AI-sleeve Alphabet exposure

rows.angle: Majorana 2 remains with DARPA for independent testing at the Maryland center; Microsoft and PsiQuantum have been in QBI Stage C since before the October additions. Only a Nov 5 Majorana lab feature this week, no new data
rows.watch for: Independent test results on the topological-qubit claims; Quantinuum partnership developments

rows.angle: Superion 256 chosen as the first on-prem QPU at NVIDIA's Accelerated Quantum Research Center (installation expected 2027, linked via NVQLink and CUDA-Q); $1B five-year US science commitment (Oct 8). Moves with the AI/chip tape (Nasdaq −5% on Nov 5)
rows.watch for: How much of the $1B reaches quantum; new NVQLink adopters; quantum remains immaterial to NVIDIA's revenue

private_watchlist.name: PsiQuantum
private_watchlist.note: In DARPA QBI Stage C with Microsoft ($125M award Jul 23, up to $300M) and finalized a $100M CHIPS R&D award on Sep 8. The Oct 8 Pentagon package added a conditional loan of up to $150M from the Office of Strategic Capital for its Milpitas, California hub; final commitment depends on conditions. Valued around $10.5B privately (~$1.5B round, May 2026). No new PsiQuantum headline found Nov 2–9.

private_watchlist.name: Atom Computing
private_watchlist.note: Joined QBI Stage C on Oct 7 alongside IBM, IonQ and Diraq; no listed security, so it is only a read-across for neutral-atom peers such as Pasqal and Infleqtion. Nov 4 note: Alice & Bob (private, France) reported cat-qubit bit-flip lifetimes above one hour.

private_watchlist.name: QuEra
private_watchlist.note: Previously reported 96 verified logical qubits and a DARPA QBI Stage B slot (not re-verified this week); not among the Stage C names. Infleqtion is now listed (INFQ, see Tier 2).

bear_case.title: Years from commercial advantage
bear_case.description: Even after IonQ's $173.8M quarter, about half of revenue is SkyWater foundry business and its GAAP operating loss was $433M; the $564M GAAP profit came from a non-cash warrant gain. D-Wave's trailing revenue is $12.43M (−44%), Rigetti's $13.35M, and Quantinuum's Q3 revenue was $9.05M with a $230M nine-month operating cash burn. Fidelity records are lab results, not revenue.

bear_case.title: Dilution and government equity
bear_case.description: IonQ raised $2B on Oct 14 (closed Oct 16) and closed the Elisity deal on Nov 4, adding shares on top of ~405M+ outstanding before warrants. Commerce holds minority equity stakes alongside $100M CHIPS awards to Rigetti, D-Wave and Quantinuum. Quantinuum's $1.94B cash cushions it, but Rigetti and D-Wave remain dependent on capital markets.

bear_case.title: Rates and the AI trade are the swing factor
bear_case.description: Nasdaq fell over 5% on Nov 5 on AI-infrastructure selling and quantum names moved with it before the Nov 6 rebound. The Fed held at 3.75–4.00% on Oct 28 in a 10–2 vote with two dissents favouring a hike, and long-duration, pre-profit multiples remain rate-sensitive. Rigetti and D-Wave have betas above 2.

bear_case.title: Drawdowns remain brutal, and relief rallies fade
bear_case.description: Despite the Nov 6 bounce, IonQ is ~56% below its $73.65 high, Rigetti ~68% below $37.14, Quantinuum ~57% below its post-IPO high (it had fallen to $29.82 on Nov 5 before jumping 26%), and Pasqal was ~78% below its high at the last quote. Analysts cut price targets on IonQ and Quantinuum after earnings even as results beat. D-Wave faces a class-action notice with a Dec 14 deadline (allegations unproven).

bear_case.title: The winner may not be listed or pure-play
bear_case.description: IBM, Microsoft, PsiQuantum, Atom Computing and Diraq sit in QBI Stage C alongside IonQ; PsiQuantum, Atom and Diraq are private and two are giants where quantum is a rounding error. Rigetti, D-Wave and Quantinuum are not on the list. DARPA's 'up to $300M' is a ceiling subject to appropriations.

stance.basis: Weights are a share of a hypothetical 100% sleeve for THIS SECTOR only — not a share of your portfolio. Core and Speculative names carry the weight; Watch and Avoid deliberately carry 0% because the point of those groups is that you are not holding them yet.

positions.name: IBM
positions.note: Nov 5–7 brought a Poughkeepsie error-correction platform with ORNL/AMD and a live on-prem System Two with the 120-qubit Nighthawk, on top of Stage C and CHIPS funding, at a valuation that does not depend on quantum.

positions.name: Alphabet
positions.note: No quantum hardware news Nov 2–9 and still outside Stage C, with Quantinuum claiming ~100x better logical fidelity (company-reported); also a large AI-sleeve holding, so avoid double-counting.

positions.name: Microsoft
positions.note: In DARPA Stage C but Majorana 2 is still under independent DARPA testing with no new results this week and the topological claims remain contested; MSFT also sits in the AI sleeve, so avoid double-counting.

positions.name: NVIDIA
positions.note: Superion 256 picked as the first on-prem QPU at NVIDIA's research center (2027) extends the CUDA-Q/NVQLink picks-and-shovels role, but quantum is immaterial to revenue, it trades with the AI tape (Nasdaq −5% Nov 5) and sits in the AI sleeve, so avoid double-counting.

positions.name: IonQ
positions.note: Q3 revenue of $173.8M (+336%), $1.2B RPO and FY26 guidance raised to $505–515M are real, but half is SkyWater, the GAAP profit was a non-cash warrant gain, and at $32.62 (~37x sales) after a +23% day it stays a small spec.

positions.name: Rigetti
positions.note: $11.75 and ~294x sales on $13.35M of TTM revenue after a +19% bounce off $9.85; Q3 is Nov 10, the Commerce equity stake brings dilution risk and it is not in Stage C.

positions.name: Quantinuum
positions.note: Beat and raise (Q3 revenue $9.05M, +233%; FY26 guide $31–34M) with $1.94B cash back its error-correction lead, but ~337x trailing sales, a $230M nine-month cash burn and a +26% one-day jump keep it small size only.

positions.name: D-Wave
positions.note: Trailing revenue of $12.43M is down 44% YoY against a ~$4.30B market cap (Oct 26 quote), a Dec 14 class-action deadline notice is outstanding (allegations unproven), and Q3 on Nov 10 is the test; avoid until bookings show up.

positions.name: Pasqal
positions.note: Last quote $5.35 was a fresh 52-week low and the first listed-company quarter (Nov 6) reportedly showed a revenue decline with QPU services growing; details unverified, so wait for the full results.

positions.name: Infleqtion
positions.note: Cheaper than peers at ~46x sales ($42.4M TTM revenue, +47%) but 30 logical qubits rely on error detection, Morgan Stanley is only Equal Weight ($12 target) and the last quote sat near its $8.38 low; no fresh price this run.
